chunks: From him, from al-Qasim ibn 'Urwah, from Abi al-'Abbas and others, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:

If a man kills a woman, the heirs of the woman are given the choice: if they wish, they may kill the man and pay half of the blood-money to his heirs; and if they wish, they may take half of the blood-money.

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءُ: the legal heirs or guardians entitled to claim retaliation or compensation
key_terms.نِصْفَ الدِّيَةِ: half of the prescribed blood-money compensation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man kills a woman in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling for retaliation and blood-money when a man kills a woman. It gives the woman's heirs a choice between qisas against the killer with payment of half the diyah to his heirs, or accepting half the diyah instead.
